categories.main_business_segments: Cintas operates two primary reportable segments: Uniform Rental and Facility Services, and First Aid and Safety Services. The Uniform Rental and Facility Services segment includes the rental and servicing of uniforms, garments, mats, mops, shop towels, restroom supplies, and related facility services. The First Aid and Safety Services segment provides first aid and safety products, services, and workplace water services. Additional operations, such as Fire Protection Services and Uniform Direct Sale, are grouped under 'All Other.'
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Cintas relies on a combination of route-based delivery, centralized processing plants for laundering and maintaining uniforms and facility products, and a distribution network for first aid, safety, and fire protection products. The company sources finished products from numerous third-party suppliers, operates five manufacturing facilities for standard uniform needs, and utilizes proprietary laundering processes designed for efficiency and environmental sustainability.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Cintas serves over one million businesses of all sizes and types, including small service and manufacturing companies as well as large corporations. Its customer base is highly diversified across industries, with no single customer accounting for more than 1% of total revenue. Key end markets include corporate, industrial, healthcare, hospitality, and public sector organizations.
categories.geographic_coverage: Cintas primarily operates in the United States, which accounts for over 90% of consolidated revenue, but also has operations in Canada and Latin America. The company maintains a broad physical presence with 490 facilities in 341 cities, including rental processing plants, branches, distribution centers, and manufacturing sites.
categories.supply_chain_position: Cintas operates primarily in the downstream segment of the supply chain, providing finished products and services directly to end customers. It manages aspects of midstream activity through its own manufacturing and processing facilities, but relies heavily on upstream suppliers for raw materials and finished goods.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Cintas' strategic priorities center on revenue growth through deeper penetration of existing customers, broadening its customer base, expanding product and service offerings, and geographic expansion. The company invests in technology, operational efficiency, and sustainability initiatives, and pursues strategic acquisitions to supplement organic growth. Innovation focuses on service delivery, environmental processes, and digital transformation.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates approximately 95% of its revenue from recurring route-based service fees for uniform rental, facility services, first aid, safety, and fire protection, performed at customer locations. The remaining revenue comes from direct sales of uniforms and related products. Revenue is recognized over time as services are performed or at a point in time for product sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Cintas competes in highly fragmented, local markets against national, regional, and local providers, including Aramark, UniFirst, ABM Industries, Rollins, and various retailers and online companies. It is North America's leading provider of corporate identity uniforms and is positioned as a market leader in related facility and safety services.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For fiscal 2025, Cintas reported total revenue of $10.34 billion, up 7.7% from the prior year, with net income of $1.81 billion and a 15.3% year-over-year increase. The company demonstrates consistent organic growth (8.0% in 2025), strong operating margins, and robust cash flow, supporting ongoing investments, dividends, and share repurchases.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Cintas differentiates itself through comprehensive, route-based service offerings that enhance customer image, safety, and cleanliness, supported by a national distribution network and strong customer relationships. The company emphasizes reliability, convenience, quality, and environmental responsibility, aiming to be a one-stop provider for business facility and employee needs.
